summary: Iteration 7 polish verification — all 7 review-request items PASS. Backend: 47/47 pytest suites still green (25s, no regressions from the new RegisterInput.password min_length=8 constraint — all existing test registers use pw>=8: 'InitialPass123!', 'Password123!', 'testpass123'). Direct curl on POST /api/auth/register: password='abc' now returns HTTP 422 with pydantic detail array containing 'String should have at least 8 characters'; password='password123' still returns HTTP 200 with token. Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): (1) main /login default mode='login' — heading 'Welcome back!', no name input, bachanta8@gmail.com/Herts@910022 navigates to /my-account with 'Welcome back!' toast; (2) /admin/login wrong password → toast title now 'Sign in failed' (verified 'Sign-in failed' with hyphen is NOT present anywhere in DOM); (3) /admin/login correct creds → navigates to /admin, toast 'Welcome, Admin', dashboard renders; (4) /login register mode + short password 'abc' (client minLength temporarily removed to reach API) → toast 'Sign up failed' with description 'String should have at least 8 characters' — no '[object Object]', no raw JSON msg/loc keys leaked; (5) /login register with password='password123' → 200 + navigation to /my-account; (6) duplicate-email register → toast 'Email already registered', mode auto-switches to login (heading flips to 'Welcome back!', name field disappears); (7) wrong password after registration → toast 'Sign in failed' + 'Invalid email or password'. Login.jsx Array.isArray flatten works correctly, minLength=8 is enforced client-side, AdminLogin.jsx title fixed. No new bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx L45 still uses regex /already/i on backend detail string to detect duplicate-email — coupled to backend copy. Recommend using HTTP status 400/409 + a machine-readable error code field. (Carried over from iter 6; not a blocker.)
Login.jsx: email/password inputs are not disabled while busy=true — only the submit button is. Minor UX polish opportunity.

AdminLogin.jsx description fallback is 'Invalid credentials' whereas the backend actually returns 'Invalid email or password' — user sees the backend copy when detail exists, but the JS fallback string differs. Cosmetic.

The new client-side password minLength=8 on Login.jsx L121 means the browser will block submit for pw<8 in real user flow; the readable-server-error path is only reachable if a malicious client bypasses HTML validation. Consider softening to a friendlier client-side hint (e.g. green-check as the user types) so the server error path becomes cosmetic-only.
